fac1b0ed919dc924.description: About the Role King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Center (KFSH) in Jeddah is seeking a Radiographer for its Cardiac Catheterization Laboratory Invasive Cardiology Lab. This full-time role focuses on maximizing radiation protection and ensuring safe radiation practices for both staff and patients. Key Responsibilities Ensure the safe and appropriate use of radiographic equipment and observe radiation safety practices within the catheterization team. Achieve optimal image quality with the lowest possible dose parameters, adhering to the As Low As Reasonably Achievable (ALARA) principle. Perform daily equipment checks, simple troubleshooting, and notify the Senior Radiographer of malfunctions or repair needs. Maintain all equipment properly and inform the Senior Radiographer of safety hazards or requirements for repair/preventative maintenance. Carry out catheterization procedures under the direction of a Cardiologist, including correct positioning of radiographic equipment and adjustment of magnification and collimation per protocol. Edit, archive, and retrieve patient images using networking and media storage systems, maintaining network accuracy daily. Collect and distribute radiation monitoring devices monthly, distribute report findings to staff, and maintain a logbook. Responsible for annual cleaning and screening of radiation protection devices, maintaining a tracking system and documentation. Ensure adequate levels of supplies and materials, informing the Senior Radiographer of any inventory reductions. Assist with emergency resuscitation measures and participate in research projects, program development, data collection, staff meetings, in-services, and continuing education. Coordinate with construction, engineering, QC, and project teams to resolve inspection issues. Prepare and maintain inspection reports, checklists, quality records, and related documentation. Ability to identify electrical quality deviations and coordinate corrective actions. Strong communication, documentation, coordination, and reporting skills. fa4c05ed2fcf851d.description: About the Role Informa PLC is seeking an Operations Manager (Events) for a 9-month contract role based in Riyadh. This position is within Portfolio 3, which is expanding its operations team to support events such as CPHI Middle East, Umrah & Ziyarah Forum, and Saudi Maritime & Logistics Congress, with additional projects planned. The Operations Manager will be responsible for the professional operational delivery of allocated events, features, and projects, ensuring high standards and stakeholder satisfaction. Company Overview Tahaluf, a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF), is a B2B live and on-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia. Tahaluf organises large-scale events such as LEAP, Cityscape, Black Hat MEA, and CPHI Middle East. The company collaborates with government and non-government organisations within Saudi Arabia's events sector. Key Responsibilities Serve as the primary contact for show teams on all matters related to allocated events, both internal and external. Manage and forecast operational show budgets for allocated events. Oversee show management and technical delivery for physical and digital events, including features. Manage the production and implementation of show project plans, ensuring timely completion of operational tasks. Ensure all allocated events comply with company H&S, Security, and Sustainability guidelines. Implement internal and external Service Level Agreements for all allocated events. Oversee the production and delivery of the show exhibitor manual. Coordinate with suppliers and show teams for brief, design, feature production, signage, and registration area management. Compile post-event reports and KPI analysis. Monitor contractor performance in collaboration with the Procurement team and address issues as needed. Manage, mentor, and develop line reports within the EMEA Operations team, balancing workloads across multiple events. Set, monitor, and manage direct reports' performance objectives and identify training needs. Collaborate with colleagues to achieve best practices in operational planning and management. Adhere to Informa compliance requirements and monitor supplier performance. Follow the HSS Operating Model for all allocated events, submitting required paperwork and embedding best practices. Work with the Informa H&S team to ensure suppliers meet and exceed H&S requirements and implement remedial measures. Actively support and enhance Informa's sustainability initiatives. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in operations, preferably within the events sector. Demonstrated ability to manage the operational delivery of events and projects. Experience in budget management and forecasting. Proficiency in managing supplier relationships and internal/external communications. Application Information Tahaluf values collaboration and ambition, seeking individuals who are proactive and contribute to team success. Hiring decisions are based on qualifications and merit, welcoming applicants from diverse backgrounds. Support and adjustments for interview or selection processes are available upon request.

fa53e7fdd6fab41a.description: About Al Qaryan Group Al Qaryan Group is seeking a Storekeeper to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position for professionals with 2-5 years of experience in storekeeping and inventory management. Role Purpose The Storekeeper is responsible for the comprehensive management of materials, spare parts, consumables, tools, and equipment. This includes receiving, inspecting, storing, and issuing these items. The role ensures the maintenance of accurate inventory records, adherence to proper storage practices, timely material issuance, and compliance with company safety and inventory-control procedures. Key Responsibilities Receive materials, spare parts, consumables, tools, and equipment from suppliers. Verify received materials against Purchase Orders (PO), Delivery Notes, and specifications. Inspect quantities and physical condition of materials, reporting any shortages, damages, or discrepancies. Properly label, categorize, and store materials in designated locations. Issue materials against approved Material Requisitions / Issue Vouchers. Maintain accurate records of all incoming and outgoing materials. Update inventory transactions in ERP/SAP or other inventory management systems. Monitor minimum and maximum stock levels and report requirements for replenishment. Conduct periodic and annual physical inventory counts and reconcile discrepancies. Maintain proper bin cards, stock registers, GRNs, issue records, and inventory documentation. Ensure implementation of FIFO/FEFO principles wherever applicable. Coordinate with Procurement, Maintenance, Production, Finance, and other departments regarding material requirements. Maintain proper housekeeping and implement 5S standards within the store. Ensure materials are stored safely and efficiently to prevent damage, deterioration, or loss. Control access to store areas and safeguard company inventory. Identify slow-moving, obsolete, damaged, and excess stock and report it to management. Follow company HSE policies and procedures, including safe material handling. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inventory/store reports as required. Experience and Qualifications 2-5 years of experience in a storekeeping or similar role. Demonstrated ability to manage inventory and maintain accurate records. Familiarity with inventory management systems such as ERP/SAP is preferred. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates on a full-time schedule. The Storekeeper will work within a team environment, collaborating with various departments to ensure efficient material flow and inventory control. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

fa7e877e112b9d3f.description: About the Role Swissport KSA is seeking a Supervisor Passenger Service for its Flynas AHB Station in Abha, Asir. This full-time role involves providing first-line leadership and guidance to employees within the Passenger Services Department, ensuring excellent customer service and regulatory compliance across check-in counters, boarding gates, and MAAS for various airlines. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities The Supervisor Passenger Service will control all functions of the Passenger Services team during shifts, ensuring timely flight departures, accurate bag accounting, and high customer satisfaction for both passengers and airlines. Responsibilities include: Performing all Passenger Service agent tasks in addition to supervisory duties. Leading, inspiring, and coaching the team to meet and exceed departmental goals and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Ensuring compliance with established departmental SOPs and conducting Pre/Post Flight Editing. Monitoring attendance of all Passenger Handling staff (Check-in, MAAS/PRM). Conducting daily staff briefings, assigning and distributing work, and reviewing work for accuracy. Ensuring cross-utilization of resources and monitoring gate and transfer desk processes per flight according to SLAs. Liaising and coordinating with the PRM team on special handling requests (WCHR/UM/DEPU). Monitoring and coordinating flight close-out as per SLAs and dispatching paperwork with the flight controller. Managing queues at the departure terminal to ensure seamless operations and maintaining professionalism in all communications. Organizing and managing resources during crisis situations such as flight disruptions, delays, or system breakdowns. Ensuring procedures established by each carrier are carried out professionally to meet or exceed service delivery targets. Updating reports for office equipment failures, discrepancies, and incidents. Ensuring employee compliance with uniform, appearance, and personnel protective equipment policies. Motivating staff and facilitating two-way communication to encourage feedback and improve efficiency. Recommending changes in practices and procedures to increase operational efficiency. Developing or modifying work plans and determining work priorities for each shift. Developing performance improvement plans, documenting performance, and providing feedback to employees. Seeking customer feedback for continuous improvement in service delivery. Tracking stationery inventory and placing orders for supplies from customer airlines. Ensuring proper coverage for deviations from daily operations (*, extra flights, charters, delayed flights) and reconciling collected monies for ad-hoc services and excess baggage. Finalizing all post-flight paperwork and activities and holding debriefings as required. Investigating operational irregularities and submitting reports/recommendations to the Duty Officer and Manager, Passenger Services. Reporting occurrences, events, violations, and acts that may affect safety, security, and company reputation. Ensuring proper logging and inventory of support tools (*, communication radios, mobile phones, tablets, WCHRs) and reporting defects immediately. Ensuring accurate and prompt submission of data capture and daily reports in defined formats or Swissport reporting tools (*, FSC, SOR, ****** Generating a summary report of all terminal activities after the end of each shift. Carrying out any additional duties as instructed by management. Qualifications and Requirements High School diploma. Demonstrated passion for customer service and relevant work experience. Flexibility to work various shifts, including days, evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Abha, Asir.

fa8fe52b31fac375.description: About the Project and Role KBR, Inc. is seeking a Senior Quantity Surveyor for a full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role is integral to a major infrastructure program for a mixed-use development in Riyadh, aiming to establish a global landmark and authentic destination. KBR provides PMO services, enterprise-level governance, assurance, integration, and performance oversight across all projects and programs within this development. Role Overview Reporting to the Senior Commercial Manager – Lead, the Senior Quantity Surveyor is responsible for coordinating with Project Management Consultants (PMCs) on various commercial aspects. This includes managing executive commercial reporting, implementing controls, recommending commercial strategies, overseeing pre and post-contract management, and providing accurate status reports to prevent schedule slippage and cost overruns. The role also involves producing close-out reports for each project. Key Responsibilities Assist in developing and implementing standard cost and commercial reporting formats for PMCs. Collaborate with PMCs to monitor construction progress by measuring and evaluating installed quantities against planned quantities. Coordinate with PMCs to compile and validate analytical commercial data. Provide analytical data for executive risk reporting. Assist in developing Project Cost Reports (PCR), Commercial Executive Reports, and Cashflows within Unifier, ensuring integration with other platforms for data consistency. Review existing procurement guidelines for Bills of Quantities (BoQ) and tender documents to develop standards for PMCs. Assist in preparing consolidated cost reports consistent with agreed reporting requirements. Support the collation of annual program-wide budgets and prepare monthly cashflow reports for client submission, review, and approval. Assist in preparing and developing cost benchmark reports for Tender Price Index, Professional Fees Benchmark, Construction Cost Benchmark for above-ground assets and infrastructure, and efficiency benchmarks (including GFA/BUA, Floor/Ceilings). Contribute to KSA Key Input Market Price Analysis (monthly) and KSA Market Insight (quarterly). Prepare cost benchmarking templates, elemental cost plan formats, and required information for PMCs. Participate in the development and implementation of program change control procedures. Assist with the preparation of project Cash Flow Reports and project cost reports, including trend analysis and change reporting. Review cost risks and opportunities. Report seamlessly between Cost Break Down Structure and Work Breakdown Structure, linking Cost and Schedule, including Earned Value. Prepare updates for changes on the Programme baseline budget to support the Business Plan exercise. Support weekly, monthly, and quarterly project progress meetings. Demonstrated experience in pre and post-contract management within large-scale infrastructure or mixed-use development projects. Proficiency in cost reporting, cashflow management, and budget analysis. Experience with Unifier or similar project control platforms is beneficial. fae84ae9401484ec.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تكامل المرافق للتشغيل والصيانة عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ الأعمال، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية لمختلف التطبيقات (المنزلية، الصناعية، التجارية) ومكوناتها. تقدير الكميات المطلوبة من المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية، وتأمين التجهيزات الضرورية لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع التأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. متابعة سير أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، والإشراف على تشغيل الدارات الكهربائية، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص الأعطال في التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، ومتابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية لضمان استمرارية الأداء. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية بكفاءة. معرفة قوية بأنواع المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد الحلول المناسبة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الكهرباء في بيئة عمل ديناميكية ضمن فريق شركة تكامل المرافق للتشغيل والصيانة في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بجدول العمل المحدد. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.
